tool_config.name: resolve_caroline_contact_phone
tool_config.description: Owner-only contact resolver for a verified-owner phone call. Use when Chris refers to a person by name and you need the exact stored contact/phone. If multiple candidates, ask which one; never guess.

name.description: Name or partial name Chris used.

tool_config.name: send_caroline_text_phone
tool_config.description: OWNER-INITIATED ONLY, VERIFIED-OWNER PHONE CHANNEL. This is the one SMS tool for both immediate and future texts during a server-verified owner phone call. When runtime says caller_identity_status=verified_owner or caller_access_tier=tier_owner, owner verification is already complete: do not refuse, ask Chris to re-verify, or move to Telegram. If Chris gives an explicit valid phone number, use it directly and do not resolve the recipient. Resolve only a named/ambiguous recipient without an exact number. If Chris explicitly instructs the send and recipient/content are clear, send directly with no confirmation round-trip. Omit execute_at for immediate send. For a future time, include a future ISO-8601 execute_at with timezone offset; interpret relative/local time in America/New_York unless Chris explicitly specifies another timezone. Do not ask for a timezone merely because the request says tomorrow, later, or a clock time. Never invent a number, contact ID, time, or authorization state.

request_body_schema.description: Explicit verified-owner phone SMS send or schedule. Timing is controlled by optional execute_at.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number, E.164. If Chris explicitly supplied an exact valid number, use it directly. Otherwise obtain it from the phone contact resolver. Never invent.

target_contact_id.description: Optional exact resolved contact UUID returned by the phone contact resolver. Never invent.

linked_call_history_id.description: Optional exact call_history UUID this replies to. Never invent.

message_summary.description: Brief faithful natural summary of what Chris wants conveyed. Do not add Caroline's transport footer yourself.

execute_at.description: Optional future ISO-8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset. Omit for immediate send. For relative/local scheduling language, resolve using America/New_York unless Chris explicitly provides another timezone. Do not ask for timezone by default.

timezone.description: Timezone for scheduled SMS. Use America/New_York by default; use another timezone only when Chris explicitly specifies one.

original_instruction.description: Optional concise faithful restatement of Chris's original scheduling instruction for provenance when execute_at is present.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_contact
tool_config.description: Owner-only unified contact reader for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Resolve the contact first, then use the exact stored phone. Choose detail_level based on the request: summary for core contact identity, permissions, relationships, instructions, and recent calls; full for the executive brief with confirmed memories, open commitments, scheduled actions, projects, and recent calls; card_only for contact-card fields, candidate observations, and provenance. Do not use from an ordinary phone call.

phone.description: Exact stored contact phone returned by resolve_caroline_contact.

detail_level.description: Select the contact view needed for this request.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_phone_admissions
tool_config.description: TELEGRAM OWNER ONLY. Review Caroline phone admission states (allow, restrict, ban, default/waitlisted) and the associated contacts/reasons. Use when Chris asks who can call Caroline, who is blocked, who is permanently banned, or which numbers are waiting for approval.

tool_config.name: set_caroline_phone_admission
tool_config.description: TELEGRAM OWNER ONLY. Control whether a phone number may enter normal Caroline voice interaction. Actions: allow = admitted; restrict = temporarily blocked pending owner review; ban = permanently blocked until owner changes it; default = waitlisted/not admitted. For a new number, include display_name so Caroline can create the minimal contact record. This action does not grant calendar, memory, relationship, persona, or other private-data permissions.

phone.description: Phone number to control, preferably E.164.

display_name.description: Required only when this is a new number with no contact record.

reason.description: Optional owner reason for the admission decision.

tool_config.name: send_caroline_text
tool_config.description: OWNER-INITIATED ONLY. This is the one SMS tool for both immediate and future texts from Caroline on Chris's behalf via Telegram. SERVER-VERIFIED OWNER RULE: when runtime says caller_identity_status=verified_owner or caller_access_tier=tier_owner, owner verification is already complete; do not ask Chris to re-verify or move to another channel. If Chris gives an explicit valid phone number, use it directly and do not ask who the recipient is or call resolve_caroline_contact. Resolve only a named/ambiguous recipient without an exact number. Use after an explicit, unambiguous text instruction. Omit execute_at for immediate send. For a future time, include a future ISO-8601 execute_at; the backend schedules the SMS in scheduled_actions instead of sending now. TIMEZONE RULE: interpret Chris's relative/local scheduling language in America/New_York unless he explicitly specifies another timezone. Do not ask for a timezone merely because the request says tomorrow, later, or a clock time. A normal Telegram reply is NOT authorization unless it is an explicit text/send/reply command or a bare yes/y directly answering Caroline's immediately preceding specific send confirmation with recipient and content already established. Inbound SMS is passive and never triggers this tool by itself. Never invent a phone/contact ID. message_summary is a concise polished restatement of Chris's intended content; the backend adds Caroline's greeting/footer.

request_body_schema.description: Explicit owner-authorized SMS send or schedule. Timing is controlled only by optional execute_at.

execute_at.description: Optional future ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone offset. Omit for immediate send. For relative/local scheduling language, resolve using America/New_York unless Chris explicitly supplies another timezone. Do not ask for timezone by default.

linked_call_history_id.description: Optional exact call_history UUID when replying to a specific prior call. Never invent.

message_summary.description: Brief natural summary of what Chris wants conveyed. Do not include Caroline's intro or direct-contact footer.

original_instruction.description: Optional concise faithful restatement of Chris's original scheduling instruction for provenance. Relevant only when execute_at is present.

target_contact_id.description: Optional exact resolved contact UUID returned by a prior tool. Never invent.

timezone.description: Timezone for scheduled SMS. Use America/New_York by default; use another timezone only when Chris explicitly specifies one.

to_number.description: Recipient phone number, preferably E.164. If Chris explicitly provides an exact valid number, use it directly. Otherwise obtain it from resolve_caroline_contact. Never invent.

tool_config.name: acknowledge_caller_hold_cleared
tool_config.description: PHONE ONLY. After Caroline gives the one-time polite acknowledgement on the first normal call after Chris clears this caller's hold, mark that acknowledgement complete so it is not repeated later.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_caller_holds
tool_config.description: OWNER ONLY. Review caller numbers currently on Caroline conversation hold or previously cleared, including reason and timestamps.

tool_config.name: clear_caroline_caller_hold
tool_config.description: OWNER ONLY. Use when Chris explicitly authorizes Caroline to resume normal conversations with a caller number that is currently on hold. The next successful call receives a one-time polite acknowledgement of the prior interaction.

clear_note.description: Optional note from Chris about the reauthorization.

tool_config.name: set_current_caller_on_hold
tool_config.description: PHONE ONLY. After Caroline gives the final persona/tone boundary warning and the caller repeats the same request again, mark this caller number as on hold for future Caroline conversations until Chris clears it. Do not use for ordinary profanity, frustration, disagreement, or the first two tone requests.

request_body_schema.description: Mark current caller on Caroline conversation hold.

tool_config.name: promote_caroline_contact_card_candidate
tool_config.description: Owner-only explicit candidate-memory promotion into a contact card. Use only after Chris reviews a candidate and clearly approves it. target_field may be behavior_notes or key_dates. For key_dates, key_date_json is a JSON object with label/date and optional notes. Never promote access_status from caller statements.

key_date_json.description: For key_dates, JSON object with label/date and optional notes.

memory_id.description: Exact candidate memory ID shown by get_caroline_contact_card or get_caroline_memories.

mode.description: For behavior_notes, append preserves existing notes; replace explicitly replaces them.

target_field.description: Card field to receive the candidate.

value.description: For behavior_notes, owner-approved text. If omitted, candidate content is used.

tool_config.name: update_caroline_contact_card
tool_config.description: Owner-only contact-card edit. Use only when Chris explicitly asks to change behavior notes, key dates, access status, assigned persona, or swearing intensity for a resolved contact. key_dates_json must be a JSON array of objects with label/date and optional notes. Persona fields are persistent owner-set calling-card preferences. This never changes authoritative identity/phone/verification/tone fields.

assigned_persona_tag.description: Optional persistent contact-card persona. Explicit owner choice only.

behavior_notes.description: Optional owner-approved behavior notes. Omit unless changing.

key_dates_json.description: Optional JSON array replacing key dates, e.g. [{"label":"Birthday","date":"10-02","notes":"year unknown"}].

phone.description: Exact stored contact phone returned by resolve_caroline_contact.

swearing_intensity.description: Optional persistent swearing allowance for the assigned persona. Explicit owner choice only.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_contact_card
tool_config.description: Owner-only contact-card review. Use after resolve_caroline_contact when Chris asks to review/edit a contact card, see behavior notes, key dates, access status, candidate observations, or provenance. Use the exact stored phone.

phone.description: Exact stored contact phone returned by resolve_caroline_contact.

tool_config.name: __caroline_regression_probe
tool_config.description: REGRESSION BRANCH ONLY. Run one self-cleaning Caroline backend regression probe mode.

tool_config.name: set_caroline_memory_status
tool_config.description: Owner-only memory lifecycle control. Use after identifying an exact memory with get_caroline_memories. Chris can confirm a candidate observation, reject it, mark it expired, or supersede it. Never promote a phone-call observation to confirmed without Chris directing or clearly approving it.

memory_id.description: Exact memory ID returned by get_caroline_memories.

superseded_by.description: Optional replacement memory ID when status is superseded.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_memories
tool_config.description: Owner-only reader for Caroline's persistent memory ledger. Use when Chris asks what Caroline remembers, wants to review candidate observations from calls, or wants to inspect confirmed memories for a contact or project. Resolve a contact first when filtering by person.

project_id.description: Optional project/topic ID to filter by.

status.description: Memory lifecycle state to return. Use confirmed by default; candidate when Chris asks what Caroline noticed; all for a full review.

subject_phone.description: Optional exact stored contact phone to filter memories by person.

tool_config.name: resolve_caroline_commitment
tool_config.description: Update an exact stored commitment after identifying it with get_caroline_commitments. Use when Chris says an obligation/follow-up was completed, cancelled, or needs reopening. Never guess a commitment ID.

commitment_id.description: Exact stored commitment ID returned by the commitment reader.

resolution_note.description: Optional concise explanation of how it was resolved or why it changed.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_commitments
tool_config.description: Read Caroline's commitment/open-loop ledger for Chris. Use when Chris asks what he or someone else still owes, what follow-ups are open, or wants to identify a commitment before resolving it.

contact_phone.description: Optional exact stored contact phone to filter by.

status.description: Filter by open, completed, cancelled, overdue, or all.

tool_config.name: create_caroline_commitment
tool_config.description: Store an owner-authorized commitment/open loop, such as 'Christopher will send the revised quote Friday' or 'I need to send Nicole the details.' Resolve a contact first when applicable. This is for actionable promises/follow-ups, not general memories.

contact_phone.description: Optional exact stored contact phone when a person is responsible or involved.

description.description: Specific promise, obligation, expected follow-up, or open loop.

due_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 due date/time with offset.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_contact_brief
tool_config.description: Owner-only executive contact brief. Use when Chris asks what Caroline knows about a person, what's going on with them, open threads, upcoming calls, recent interactions, or relevant confirmed memories. Resolve the contact first, then use the exact stored phone.

phone.description: Exact stored contact phone returned by resolve_caroline_contact.

tool_config.name: remember_caroline_context
tool_config.description: Store an owner-confirmed persistent memory for Caroline from Chris's authorized Telegram chat. Use when Chris explicitly says to remember a fact, preference, follow-up, relationship observation, or context note. Resolve a contact first when the memory is about a person. Do not use phone-caller assertions as owner-confirmed memory.

content.description: Concise memory content preserving Chris's meaning.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiry for temporary facts/context.

project_id.description: Optional existing project ID when the memory belongs to a known topic/project.

subject_phone.description: Optional exact stored contact phone when this memory is about a person.

tool_config.name: cancel_caroline_scheduled_action
tool_config.description: Owner-only cancellation for a future/failed Caroline scheduled action. First identify the exact action with get_caroline_scheduled_actions. Cancelling also cancels its linked calendar event. Never guess an action ID.

scheduled_action_id.description: Exact scheduled action ID returned by the list tool.

tool_config.name: update_caroline_scheduled_action
tool_config.description: Owner-only editor for a stored scheduled Caroline action. First identify the exact scheduled_action_id with get_caroline_scheduled_actions. Use for rescheduling or changing the call purpose, talking points, questions, facts, desired outcome, or special instructions. Never guess an action ID.

execute_at.description: Optional new ISO 8601 execution time with timezone offset.

reschedule.description: Set true when explicitly retrying/rescheduling a previously failed action.

scheduled_action_id.description: Exact scheduled action ID returned by the list tool.

talking_points.description: Replacement talking points when Chris changes them.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_scheduled_actions
tool_config.description: Owner-only reader for future or recent Caroline scheduled actions. Use when Chris asks what calls/actions are scheduled, wants to find an action before editing/cancelling it, or asks what a future call is supposed to cover.

status.description: Filter by scheduled, reserved, executing, completed, failed, cancelled, or all.

target_phone.description: Optional exact stored contact phone to filter by.

tool_config.name: schedule_caroline_call
tool_config.description: Schedule a future Caroline outbound call from Chris's authorized Telegram chat. Use after resolving the target to an exact stored contact. This creates both a private calendar event and a durable scheduled action. Capture the purpose, talking points, questions, facts to convey, desired outcome, and special boundaries Chris gives you. Do not use for an immediate call; use initiate_caroline_outbound_call for calls Chris wants now.

calendar_title.description: Optional concise calendar title, e.g. Call Christopher — contract renewal.

desired_outcome.description: What result Chris wants from the conversation.

execute_at.description: ISO 8601 execution time with timezone offset. Interpret Chris's natural-language date/time in America/New_York unless he explicitly specifies another timezone.

expected_duration_minutes.description: Calendar block length for the call, normally 30 unless context indicates otherwise.

facts_to_convey.description: Facts or messages Chris explicitly wants communicated.

items.description: One fact or message to convey.

original_instruction.description: Concise faithful restatement of Chris's scheduling instruction for provenance.

project_name.description: Optional project/topic this call belongs to. If no active project with this name exists, one may be created.

purpose.description: Why Chris wants the call made.

questions_to_ask.description: Questions Caroline should ask the contact.

special_instructions.description: Boundaries or special directions, e.g. do not commit on price.

target_phone.description: Exact stored phone returned by resolve_caroline_contact.

tool_config.name: resolve_caroline_contact
tool_config.description: Owner-only contact resolver for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Use when Chris refers to a person by name and you need the exact stored contact/phone before a contact-specific action. If more than one candidate is returned, ask Chris which person; never guess.

request_body_schema.description: Resolve a stored contact by name or phone.

name.description: Name or partial name Chris used, such as Christopher. Use when a phone number was not supplied.

tool_config.name: query_caroline_shared_schedule
tool_config.description: Read-only phone-call schedule query. Use only for a verified caller when calendar_share_level is not none and the caller asks about Chris's schedule beyond the injected current/next context. The viewer phone is supplied by ElevenLabs system caller identity and must not be replaced from caller claims. Omit subject_phone for Chris's calendar; use an existing contact phone only when the caller explicitly asks about that contact and access is allowed.

subject_phone.description: Optional existing contact whose schedule is requested. Omit for Chris.

tool_config.name: set_caroline_calendar_share
tool_config.description: Owner-only calendar sharing control. Use when Chris explicitly grants, changes, or removes a verified contact's ability to see his calendar or another existing contact's calendar. Share levels are none, busy_only, title, or details.

notes.description: Optional owner note explaining the share rule.

share_level.description: Maximum schedule detail the viewer may receive.

subject_phone.description: Optional existing contact whose calendar is being shared. Omit for Chris's calendar.

viewer_phone.description: Existing contact who is being granted or denied schedule visibility.

tool_config.name: find_caroline_open_slots
tool_config.description: Owner-only free-slot finder for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Use when Chris asks when he or an explicitly named existing contact is free within a time window.

duration_minutes.description: Minimum desired free-slot duration in minutes.

phone.description: Optional existing contact phone. Omit for Chris's calendar.

tool_config.name: cancel_caroline_calendar_event
tool_config.description: Owner-only calendar cancellation for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Use only after the intended stored event is unambiguous.

event_id.description: Exact stored calendar event ID to cancel.

tool_config.name: create_caroline_calendar_event
tool_config.description: Owner-only calendar event creation for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Use only when Chris explicitly asks to add, schedule, block, or create an event. Omit phone for Chris's own calendar; use an existing contact phone only when Chris explicitly asks to create an event on that contact's calendar.

end_at.description: ISO 8601 event end with timezone offset.

phone.description: Optional existing contact phone. Omit for Chris's calendar.

start_at.description: ISO 8601 event start with timezone offset.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_calendar
tool_config.description: Owner-only calendar reader for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Use when Chris asks what is on his calendar, what he is doing now, or what is scheduled in a time window. Omit phone for Chris's own calendar; supply an existing contact phone only when Chris explicitly asks about that contact's calendar.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of events, 1 to 100.

phone.description: Optional existing contact phone. Omit for Chris's calendar.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_instructions
tool_config.description: Owner-only reader for Caroline's stored operating instructions. Use when Chris asks what instructions are active/stored, wants to review instructions before cancelling one, or asks what applies globally or to a contact.

phone.description: Optional existing contact phone number. When supplied, return global instructions plus instructions for that contact.

status.description: Stored status filter. Use active by default; all when Chris asks to review everything.

tool_config.name: retry_caroline_notifications
tool_config.description: Owner-only recovery action for Caroline's automatic Telegram call/event notifications. Use when Chris explicitly asks to retry a failed/pending brief or recover recent undelivered notifications.

conversation_id.description: Optional exact conversation whose automatic brief should be retried.

event_id.description: Optional exact operational event notification to retry.

limit.description: When no exact target is supplied, retry up to this many recent pending or failed calls/events, maximum 10.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_system_status
tool_config.description: Owner-only Caroline system status reader. Use for system/readiness diagnostics, persistent-state counts, configuration checks, or pending/failed notifications. Do NOT use merely to answer Chris's current availability when {{availability_status}} already contains the answer; respond directly from that runtime value. Use this tool for availability only when Chris explicitly asks to inspect the stored/backend availability record or diagnose a mismatch.

tool_config.name: cancel_caroline_instruction
tool_config.description: Owner-only instruction cancellation for Caroline. Use when Chris explicitly asks to stop or cancel a previously stored instruction.

tool_config.name: create_caroline_instruction
tool_config.description: Owner-only instruction creation for Caroline. Use when Chris explicitly gives a global instruction or an instruction for a specific existing contact, including temporary instructions with an expiry.

durable.description: True only when Chris intends this to persist beyond a temporary window.

priority.description: Optional priority from 0 to 1000; higher wins.

scope_type.description: Whether the instruction applies globally or only to one contact.

tool_config.name: set_caroline_relationship
tool_config.description: Owner-only relationship update between two existing Caroline contacts. Use only when Chris explicitly states or changes the relationship between two identified contacts.

notes.description: Optional owner context about the relationship.

relationship_type.description: Relationship label such as sibling, partner, colleague, parent, child, or friend.

tool_config.name: set_caroline_contact_permission
tool_config.description: Owner-only permission update for a Caroline contact. In the current build, the implemented permission is general_availability, controlling whether a verified known contact may receive the current general availability state.

allowed.description: Whether general availability disclosure is allowed for this contact.

notes.description: Optional owner note explaining the permission decision.

permission_key.description: Current supported permission: disclosure of general availability to a verified known contact.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_contact_context
tool_config.description: Owner-only contact context lookup for Caroline's Telegram control channel. Use when Chris asks what Caroline knows about a contact, their permissions, instructions, relationships, or recent call history.

tool_config.name: upsert_caroline_contact
tool_config.description: Owner-only contact create/update action for Caroline's Telegram control channel. For an existing contact, send only fields Chris explicitly changes; omitted fields are preserved. For a new contact, include a display name. Never infer verification, access, or relationship-to-owner from caller claims.

request_body_schema.description: Owner-authorized contact create or partial update.

contact_type.description: Owner-selected contact classification. Omit to preserve an existing value.

display_name.description: Contact display name. Required when creating a new contact; omit on an existing contact to preserve the current name.

first_name.description: Optional first name. Send only when Chris explicitly supplies or changes it.

last_name.description: Optional last name. Send only when Chris explicitly supplies or changes it.

notes.description: Optional owner notes. Send only when Chris explicitly supplies or changes them.

relationship_to_owner.description: Chris-approved relationship of this contact to Chris, such as girlfriend, brother, close friend, client, supervisor, or vendor. Never infer this from the caller's own claim. Omit to preserve the existing value.

tone_profile.description: Owner-selected conversational tone profile. Omit to preserve an existing value.

verification_status.description: Owner-selected verification state. Never promote based only on caller claims. Omit to preserve an existing value.

tool_config.name: get_caroline_call_log
tool_config.description: Read Caroline's canonical Supabase call log for Chris from the authorized Telegram owner chat. Use when Chris asks about recent calls, a specific caller or conversation, what happened on a call, whether a post-call notification was sent, or requests transcript details. Never use from a phone call or unauthorized Telegram chat.

conversation_id.description: Optional exact ElevenLabs conversation ID when Chris refers to a specific conversation.

include_events.description: Set true when Chris asks about failed call attempts, initiation status, operational events, or delivery diagnostics. When phone is supplied, events are restricted to that caller's conversations or event details.

include_transcript.description: Set true only when Chris asks for transcript details, exact wording, or what was said.

limit.description: Number of recent records to return, from 1 to 10.

phone.description: Optional caller or callee phone number to filter by. Prefer E.164 when known.

tool_config.name: initiate_caroline_outbound_call
tool_config.description: Initiate a native Twilio voice call from Caroline to a target number, but only from Chris's authorized Telegram control chat after an explicit call directive. Never use during a phone call or from an unauthorized Telegram chat. The target must be a real phone number and is normalized by Supabase.

to_number.description: Destination phone number. Prefer E.164 format. Never invent a number; resolve it from the owner's explicit instruction or verified contact context.

tool_config.name: set_caroline_availability
tool_config.description: Update Chris's authoritative availability state from the authorized Telegram owner chat. Use only for explicit owner availability directives such as working hours, available/unavailable, busy, or off. Never use this during phone calls or from an unauthorized Telegram chat.

available_from.description: Optional ISO 8601 availability start with timezone offset. Omit when not applicable.

available_until.description: Optional ISO 8601 availability end with timezone offset. Omit when not applicable.

human_readable.description: Short natural-language availability statement Caroline may use when disclosure is permitted.

status.description: Normalized availability state: available, unavailable, busy, or unknown.

tool_config.name: telegram_react_to_message
tool_config.description: React to the user's triggering message in the current Telegram chat with a single emoji. Use this when a short emotional acknowledgment is more natural than a text reply (for example 👍 for agreement, 🎉 for celebration, ❤ for warmth). The target `chat_id` and `message_id` are bound to the originating webhook conversation; the model cannot retarget another chat or message. Setting a new reaction replaces any reaction the bot previously set on the same message. Only one emoji per call; if the chat restricts available reactions, the API call may fail — fall back to a text reply in that case.

request_body_schema.description: Reaction parameters. `chat_id` and `message_id` are bound to the originating webhook conversation; the model cannot retarget another chat or message. The model only chooses the `emoji`.

emoji.description: The single emoji to react with. Must be one of Telegram's predefined bot-allowed reaction emoji. The chat may further restrict which reactions are allowed; if the API rejects the call, reply with text instead.

tool_config.name: telegram_get_chat
tool_config.description: Get information about a chat, such as its title, type, description, and member count. Use this to understand the context of the conversation.

request_body_schema.description: Chat identifier. `chat_id` is bound to the originating webhook conversation; the model cannot retarget another chat.

tool_config.name: telegram_send_message
tool_config.description: Reply to the user in the current Telegram chat. The destination chat is fixed to the conversation that invoked the agent and cannot be redirected. Only send messages when the user explicitly asks you to.

request_body_schema.description: Message parameters. `chat_id` is bound to the originating webhook conversation; the model cannot retarget another chat.

text.description: Text of the message to be sent (1-4096 characters)

parse_mode.description: Mode for parsing entities in the message text. If omitted, the message is sent as plain text with no formatting.
